name: v2-pause-host-sends-motion
covers: motion sent during a simulated pause
review: The four recorded motions are X0 to X10, X10 to X20 while suspended, the source-defined restore to saved X10, and X10 to X30: at 80 steps/mm these give +800, +800, -800 and +1600 steps. Independent acceleration calculations agree with their durations within 0.13%. Player.cpp asks the host to stop sending and restores the saved position during M601; both firmware revisions reproduced the trace and required messages. This is a host-simulator observation, not a claim that motion during pause is safe or desired; real-host and board behavior remain unverified.
